ms.promise:
Event Execution: Ensure the smooth implementation of the hackathon activities according to the schedule. Activities include opening (keynote, rules briefing), coding time (24h) and closing (presentations, winner announcements).
Technical Support: Provide real-time technical support to participants, helping resolve issues and answer queries. Support covers equipment (hardware troubleshooting), software platforms (access issues), and general problem-solving (rules or submissions).
Jury Organization: Organize a jury panel to evaluate and select winning projects based on established criteria. Jury of 4 experts evaluates projects based on innovation, feasibility, presentation, and impact. The judges will have a Q&A session with the teams, then evaluate and announce the winning teams. The evaluation process takes place 15-30 minutes after all teams have finished pitching.

ms.criteria:
Feedback Collection: Collect actionable feedback from participants, judges, and stakeholders that can be used for future event improvements. Achieve a response rate of at least 70% from distributed surveys.
Results Disclosure: Ensure winners are announced and the results are shared widely with the community. Set a target engagement rate (e.g., reach at least 5,000 views and 500 interactions across platforms).
Final closeout Report and Video: A comprehensive final report and video highlighting the event’s successes, challenges, and impact are produced and shared with all involved.
